library(shiny)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(bslib) # Added for professional theming

# Define UI with a clean, modern theme
ui <- navbarPage("Least Squares Explorer",
                 theme = bs_theme(version = 5, bootswatch = "yeti"), # Professional theme
                 
                 # TAB 1: The Game
                 tabPanel("1. Guess the Line",
                          sidebarLayout(
                            sidebarPanel(
                              width = 3, # Adjusted for better space usage
                              h4("Can you beat the algorithm?"),
                              p("Adjust the slope and intercept to fit the points as best as you can."),
                              hr(),
                              sliderInput("guess_intercept", "Your Intercept:", min = -5, max = 5, value = 0, step = 0.01),
                              sliderInput("guess_slope", "Your Slope:", min = -5, max = 5, value = 0, step = 0.01),
                              
                              # Subtle toggle for residuals
                              checkboxInput("show_residuals", "Show Residuals", value = FALSE),
                              
                              br(),
                              actionButton("check_btn", "Check Answer!", class = "btn-primary w-100"),
                              br(), br(),
                              actionButton("new_data_btn", "Generate New Data", class = "btn-secondary w-100"),
                              hr(),
                              uiOutput("score_ui")
                            ),
                            mainPanel(
                              width = 9, # Gives the plot much more breathing room
                              # Increased height to fill white space
                              plotOutput("game_plot", height = "700px") 
                            )
                          )
                 ),
                 
                 # TAB 2: Optimization
                 tabPanel("2. Optimization Journey",
                          sidebarLayout(
                            sidebarPanel(
                              width = 3,
                              h4("Numerical Optimization"),
                              p("Watch gradient descent find the optimal line."),
                              hr(),
                              sliderInput("opt_init_intercept", "Initial Intercept Guess:", min = -5, max = 5, value = -4, step = 0.01),
                              sliderInput("opt_init_slope", "Initial Slope Guess:", min = -5, max = 5, value = -3, step = 0.01),
                              sliderInput("opt_iteration", "Iteration:", 
                                          min = 1, max = 50, value = 1, step = 1, 
                                          # Sped up the animation for smoothness
                                          animate = animationOptions(interval = 150, loop = FALSE)), 
                              helpText("The red dot represents the current parameters on the loss surface.")
                            ),
                            mainPanel(
                              width = 9,
                              fluidRow(
                                # Splitting the space exactly 50/50 for the two plots
                                column(6, plotOutput("opt_line_plot", height = "650px")),
                                column(6, plotlyOutput("opt_surface_plot", height = "650px"))
                              )
                            )
                          )
                 )
)

# Define Server
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  rv <- reactiveValues(
    data = NULL,
    true_b0 = NULL,
    true_b1 = NULL,
    show_answer = FALSE,
    opt_path = NULL,
    surface_grid = NULL
  )
  
  generate_data <- function() {
    x <- runif(50, -2, 2)
    true_b0 <- runif(1, -2, 2)
    true_b1 <- runif(1, -2, 2)
    true_sd <- 10^runif(1,-1,0.5)
    y <- true_b0 + true_b1 * x + rnorm(50, 0, true_sd)
    
    rv$data <- data.frame(x = x, y = y)
    
    fit <- lm(y ~ x, data = rv$data)
    rv$true_b0 <- coef(fit)[1]
    rv$true_b1 <- coef(fit)[2]
    rv$show_answer <- FALSE
    
    b0_seq <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 40)
    b1_seq <- seq(-5, 5, length.out = 40)
    
    z_matrix <- matrix(nrow = length(b0_seq), ncol = length(b1_seq))
    for(i in 1:length(b0_seq)) {
      for(j in 1:length(b1_seq)) {
        preds <- b0_seq[i] + b1_seq[j] * x
        z_matrix[i, j] <- sqrt(mean((y - preds)^2)) 
      }
    }
    rv$surface_grid <- list(x = b0_seq, y = b1_seq, z = z_matrix)
  }
  
  observeEvent(session, { generate_data() }, once = TRUE)
  observeEvent(input$new_data_btn, { generate_data() })
  observeEvent(input$check_btn, { rv$show_answer <- TRUE })
  
  calc_rmse <- function(b0, b1) {
    preds <- b0 + b1 * rv$data$x
    sqrt(mean((rv$data$y - preds)^2))
  }
  
  # -- TAB 1 OUTPUTS --
  output$game_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(rv$data)
    p <- ggplot(rv$data, aes(x, y)) + 
      # Highlight the origin axes to clearly show intercepts
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8)
    
    # Draw colored residuals if the box is checked
    if (input$show_residuals) {
      p <- p + geom_segment(aes(xend = x, 
                                yend = input$guess_intercept + input$guess_slope * x,
                                color = y > (input$guess_intercept + input$guess_slope * x)), 
                            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
        scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#27AE60", "FALSE" = "#E74C3C"))
    }
    
    p <- p + geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.6, color = "#2C3E50") +
      geom_abline(intercept = input$guess_intercept, slope = input$guess_slope, 
                  color = "#3498DB", linewidth = 1.5, linetype = "dashed") +
      # Professional theming and borders
      theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
      theme(
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 1, fill = NA),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3, 3), ylim = c(-8, 8)) +
      labs(title = "Interactive Fit vs. Data", x = "Predictor (X)", y = "Response (Y)")
    
    if (rv$show_answer) {
      p <- p + geom_abline(intercept = rv$true_b0, slope = rv$true_b1, 
                           color = "#E74C3C", linewidth = 1.5, linetype = "dashed") +
        labs(title = "Your Line (Blue) vs. True Least Squares Line (Red)")
    }
    p
  })
  
  output$score_ui <- renderUI({
    req(rv$show_answer)
    user_rmse <- calc_rmse(input$guess_intercept, input$guess_slope)
    true_rmse <- calc_rmse(rv$true_b0, rv$true_b1)
    
    score <- max(0, (true_rmse / user_rmse) * 100)
    
    # Updated decimal precision to 5 places
    tagList(
      h5(sprintf("Your RMSE: %.5f", user_rmse)),
      h5(sprintf("Optimal RMSE: %.5f", true_rmse), style = "color: #E74C3C;"),
      h3(sprintf("Accuracy Score: %.1f%%", score), style = "color: #27AE60; font-weight: bold;")
    )
  })
  
  # -- TAB 2 OUTPUTS --
  observe({
    req(rv$data)
    b0 <- input$opt_init_intercept
    b1 <- input$opt_init_slope
    lr <- 0.1 
    iterations <- 50
    path <- data.frame(iter = 1:iterations, b0 = numeric(iterations), b1 = numeric(iterations), rmse = numeric(iterations))
    
    for(i in 1:iterations) {
      path$b0[i] <- b0
      path$b1[i] <- b1
      path$rmse[i] <- calc_rmse(b0, b1)
      
      preds <- b0 + b1 * rv$data$x
      error <- preds - rv$data$y
      grad_b0 <- 2 * mean(error)
      grad_b1 <- 2 * mean(error * rv$data$x)
      
      b0 <- b0 - lr * grad_b0
      b1 <- b1 - lr * grad_b1
    }
    rv$opt_path <- path
  })
  
  output$opt_line_plot <- renderPlot({
    req(rv$data, rv$opt_path)
    current_step <- rv$opt_path[input$opt_iteration, ]
    
    ggplot(rv$data, aes(x, y)) + 
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.5, color = "#2C3E50") +
      geom_abline(intercept = current_step$b0, slope = current_step$b1, 
                  color = "#E74C3C", linewidth = 1.5) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
      theme(
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 1, fill = NA),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3, 3), ylim = c(-8, 8)) +
      labs(title = sprintf("Iteration: %d | RMSE: %.5f", input$opt_iteration, current_step$rmse),
           x = "Predictor (X)", y = "Response (Y)")
  })
  
  output$opt_surface_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(rv$surface_grid, rv$opt_path)
    
    current_step <- rv$opt_path[input$opt_iteration, ]
    
    plot_ly() %>%
      add_surface(x = rv$surface_grid$x, y = rv$surface_grid$y, z = t(rv$surface_grid$z), 
                  opacity = 0.9, colorscale = "Viridis") %>%
      add_markers(x = current_step$b0, y = current_step$b1, z = current_step$rmse,
                  marker = list(color = '#E74C3C', size = 8, symbol = 'circle', 
                                line = list(color = 'white', width = 2)),
                  name = "Current State") %>%
      layout(title = list(text = "RMSE Loss Surface", font = list(size = 16, family = "Arial", color = "black")),
             scene = list(
               xaxis = list(title = "Intercept", backgroundcolor="white", gridcolor="lightgray"),
               yaxis = list(title = "Slope", backgroundcolor="white", gridcolor="lightgray"),
               zaxis = list(title = "RMSE", backgroundcolor="white", gridcolor="lightgray")
             ),
             margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, b = 10, t = 50),
             # The magic fix: Lock camera unless the "New Data" button is pressed!
             uirevision = input$new_data_btn) 
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
